## Gravity-work fixer (`gravity-work-fixer`) {#sec-ch06-fixer}

### Summary

The gravity-work fixer repaired the energy budget of the cell form: once per step it removed the defect
@eq-ch06-cell-defect from the domain's total energy, spreading it over the cells in proportion to their mass. V3
has neither the cell form nor the fixer. The key `gravity-work-fixer` stays readable so that decks which switch the
fixer off keep loading; `true` is refused at setup. With the face form, the only form at the pin, there is no
defect to remove (@sec-ch06-face).

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** None at the pin: the fixer is not in the code; this section records the key and its refusal.

**Data.** The boolean key `gravity-work-fixer` of the `const-gravity` block.

**Placement.** Setup only.

**Activation.** `false` or absent loads; `true` is refused.

**Guarantee / limits.** The face form's $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+P$ needs no fixer (@sec-ch06-conserves).

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch06-fixer-tests: `test_gravity_work_fixer_removed_python`.
:::

Local symbols: $\mathcal D$[^rg-b660c0a73eb0] the step's defect of the cell form [J]; $w^{(s)}_{\mathrm{step}}$ the weight of stage $s$
in the step [-]; $M=\sum_jV_j\rho_j$ the total mass of the block [kg].

### Derivation

What the fixer did, stated for the reader of @eq-ch06-fixer-fix where another chapter cites it. With the per-stage
defects $\mathcal D^{(s)}$ of @eq-ch06-cell-defect weighted by each stage's share of the step,
$w^{(s)}_{\mathrm{step}}=w_2^{(s)}\prod_{s'>s}w_1^{(s')}$ ($1/6$, $1/6$, $2/3$ for rk3), it applied after the last stage

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal D &= \sum_sw^{(s)}_{\mathrm{step}}\,\mathcal D^{(s)} ,\\
E_i &\leftarrow E_i - \mathcal D\,\frac{\rho_i}{M},
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch06-fixer-fix}

so that $\sum_iV_i\Delta E_i=-\mathcal D$. That restores the domain total of $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ but moves
energy between columns and levels that the flow never exchanged: a global repair of a local booking error. The face
form books the work where the mass crosses and closes the budget column by column, so V3 keeps the face form and
drops both the cell form and its fixer.

### Numerical method

None at the pin. Setup reads the key and refuses `true` in two places: the `const-gravity` reader, for a deck, and
`HydroImpl::reset`, for options built in Python
({{< code src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}},
{{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}).

@fig-ch06-fixer-flow shows, for readers of the diagnostics that refer to it, the order of the operations the fixer
ran in one step: the per-stage defects, their stage weights, and the deposit after the last stage. None of it runs
at the pin.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch06-fixer-flow
#| fig-cap: "The step of the gravity-work fixer that V3 does not have: each stage's defect is collected with its stage weight, and after the last stage the weighted sum is removed from the energy in proportion to the cell mass. Shown for the diagnostics that refer to it; nothing in this figure runs at the pin."
#| fig-alt: "A flow diagram of the stages of one step with the defect collected at each stage and a deposit box after the last stage."
```

### Code

**A minimal input.** A deck written for the fixer still loads when it switches the fixer off:

```yaml
forcing:
  const-gravity:
    grav1: -9.8
    gravity-work-fixer: false   # the only accepted value; or drop the key
```

**What is refused, and why.** `gravity-work-fixer: true`, from YAML and from Python options, with a message
that names the V3 removal and says to set the key false or drop it. There is no defect for it to repair.

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| deck refusal | {{< code src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}} | `gravity_work_fixer` | `gravity-work-fixer` |
| options refusal | {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}} | `gravity_work_fixer` | `gravity-work-fixer` |

: Code map of the refused gravity-work fixer. {#tbl-ch06-fixer-code}

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
- A deck that sets `gravity-work-fixer: true` does not load; set it `false` or drop the key.
- The cycle line has no fixer field at the pin (`print_cycle_line`,
  {{< code src/diagnostics/budget.cpp print_cycle_line >}}); diagnostics written for the fixer's amount have nothing
  to read (@sec-ch06-conserves).
:::

Combinations with the study switches: @sec-ch12-matrix.
